pageRequestProofSnapshot.countSemantics: Counts classify lab URL receipts with original capture/attempt proof, not unique HTTP requests or fresh wire events. Historical797=715page-proven+82prechecks; historical83=78page-proven+5prechecks.
pageRequestProofSnapshot.proofRule: Top-level page httpStatus (including0), explicit actualPageRequestMade with a recorded wire, or an initial page HTTP redirect whose from is the evaluated target. Nested robots.httpStatus does not prove a page request. Original cached HTTP200 proves its prior capture only and never implies a fresh live request.
pageRequestProofSnapshot.originalReceiptMatchingBoundary: Selected frozen captures are matched against collector/gap original fetch JSON or retained attemptHistory JSON, rather than requiring equality with a mutable collector latest fetch. Original selected observations are never replaced by newer collector attempts.
